event.title: China Unveils Advanced Humanoid Robots Amid US Trade Restrictions
event.canonical_title: China Unveils Advanced Humanoid Robots Amid US Trade Restrictions
event.summary: During the World Robot Conference held in Beijing on August 19, over 300 companies showcased a variety of humanoid, industrial, and service robots. This event underscores the robotics sector's increasing integration into factories and commercial environments, particularly in light of US trade restrictions affecting firms operating abroad.

timeline.title: Humanoid Robots Break Records at World Games in Beijing
timeline.summary: The World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing showcased various sports, including sprinting and high jump, with robots participating in these events. Notably, a robot set a new record by completing the 100-meter sprint in 9.39 seconds, surpassing Usain Bolt's previous world record.

Robots competed in sprinting and high jump
A robot broke Usain Bolt's 100-meter sprint record with a time of 9.39 seconds
